WEFT-154.name: ws05: Email channel — implement IMAP poll loop and SMTP outbound send
WEFT-154.description:
Source
audit: 05-channels.md (Stubbed runtime table; Task List #4)
code: crates/clawft-channels/src/email/channel.rs:166-217
prior planning: .planning/sparc/phase4/06-channel-enhancements/02-phase-EEnterprise-email-gchat-teams.md
Problem / gap
The Email ChannelAdapter ships with a passing test suite but the runtime is a stub. start() polls with debug!("polling for new emails (stub)") and never opens an IMAP connection; send() fabricates a synthetic <ts-target@host> Message-ID without invoking SMTP. With --features email, the gateway will start cleanly, accept outbound send() calls, and silently drop every message. The Element-06 tracker reports this as complete; it is not.
Acceptance criteria
[ ] start() opens an IMAP connection (using imap crate behind the email feature), polls INBOX with IDLE or interval-based fetch, parses RFC822 messages, and emits real InboundMessage/MessagePayload events to the host
[ ] send() constructs a MIME message via lettre and submits to SMTP with TLS; the returned message id is the real Message-ID returned by the server
[ ] Auth supports both password/password_env and (at minimum) STARTTLS + implicit TLS
[ ] Reconnect-with-backoff on transport errors; cancellation respected
[ ] Unit + integration tests against a mock IMAP/SMTP harness (or an embedded test server)
[ ] scripts/build.sh test and scripts/build.sh clippy --features email pass
[ ] 04-element-06-tracker.md updated to reflect real I/O landed (no longer "stub IMAP/SMTP runtime")
Dependencies
blocks: any production deployment of --features email
blocked-by: none
Notes
E2 was tracked under E-Enterprise. The imap and lettre deps are not yet in clawft-channels/Cargo.toml. Channel-stub WARN headers and tracing::warn! on start() landed in this session (documentation half); this item is the real I/O implementation.

WEFT-10.name: ws01: bootstrap — split workspace from global at loader for PermissionResolver ceiling
WEFT-10.description:
Source
.planning/reviews/0.7.0-release-gate/01-core-platform.md — TODO at crates/clawft-core/src/bootstrap.rs:633 and Task List row 3. Same root cause as ws06 MW-2.
Problem / gap
Current bootstrap.rs deep-merges the workspace overlay into a single Config upstream so workspace policy reaches PermissionResolver but enforce_workspace_ceiling never runs. Workspace permissions are not clamped against system-wide bounds. Acceptable for single-user kernels, blocks multi-tenant. Marked TODO(v1.1) in source.
Acceptance criteria
[ ] Loader returns (global: Config, workspace: Option<Config>) or equivalent.
[ ] bootstrap calls PermissionResolver::new(global, Some(workspace)).
[ ] enforce_workspace_ceiling clamps workspace permissions per FIX-04 rules (level<=1, no budget/rate-limit increases, tools subset of global).
[ ] Test: workspace .clawft/config.json granting elevated perms is silently clamped, with audit-log warning emitted.
[ ] Multi-tenant scenario covered by integration test.
Dependencies
Cross-listed with ws06 MW-2 (memory/workspace audit). Coordinate so the fix lands once.
Notes
Single-tenant deploys are unaffected; promote to 0.7.x only if multi-tenant lands sooner.

WEFT-44.name: ws03: service-llm — handle non-string content (vision blocks / structured) in LlmClient
WEFT-44.description:
Source
.planning/reviews/0.7.0-release-gate/03-pipeline-routing.md — Task 03-23; Q16; the recently-landed 8b05d868 covers null-content but not array content.
Code: crates/clawft-service-llm/src/client.rs.
Problem / gap
The null-content deserializer (8b05d868) covers the Nemotron tool-call case. OpenAI vision API and others emit content as an array of content blocks ([{type: "text", text: "..."}, {type: "image_url", ...}]). Current String field with null→"" mapping does not handle that — calls fail with a serde error.
Acceptance criteria
[ ] Switch content to a typed enum: String | Array<ContentBlock> | Null.
[ ] Consumer code adapts (most paths can flatten Array→String for now).
[ ] Test fixtures: OpenAI vision response, Anthropic-style blocks, Nemotron null.
[ ] Backward-compat: existing string responses still parse.
Dependencies
None.
Notes
Not 0.7.0-blocker because vision is not yet a 0.7.0 feature, but extending the current String shape is cheap insurance.
